theory.heading: What MERN GenAI Testing is
theory.body: MERN GenAI Testing describes the methods and patterns used within MERN Stack + Gen AI to achieve reliable, maintainable results. Understanding it is the foundation for everything built later in this course.

theory.heading: Why MERN GenAI Testing matters
theory.body: Without MERN GenAI Testing, systems built with MERN Stack + Gen AI are harder to debug, extend and operate. Teams that master this topic ship fewer defects and communicate more clearly about design decisions.

theory.heading: How MERN GenAI Testing works
theory.body: The mechanism behind MERN GenAI Testing follows a repeatable sequence: understand the requirement, apply the principle, verify the result and refine based on feedback. Each step has checks that keep the work on track.

theory.heading: Advantages and limitations of MERN GenAI Testing
theory.body: MERN GenAI Testing offers structure, clarity and consistency, but it also adds overhead and may be overkill for trivial tasks. Use it when the benefit in reliability outweighs the added effort.
points: Limitations: added overhead, not always needed.
